source: The 1D PGC example (src/examples.ts 'pgc', S1R-equivalent) as the app sends it (scripts/native-protocol.mjs prepareNativeSolve, motion along z at 30 uK), and gme.py's reference numbers for it (the G1-model research module of 2026-11-02, REPORT.md sections 3, 4 and 6; run in the production basis on these exact inputs, k_ref from the first beam along the axis). Matrices are lists of nonzero entries [row, column, re, im], the reference operators their secular (block-diagonal) parts to 12 significant digits: harmonics keyed by m, X and P by 'carrier,emitted,absorbed', jumps by axis, carrier and blocks with L and D2 keyed by s; the first-order increments at the shift kv*s, the exact response at shift, the readout at theta of the density rho.
